correctness.rationale: The unrestricted single-window ball is partitioned by first changed coordinate. The four-bit local values and terminal triple produce the stated 4-state matrix exactly; extracting coefficients of its formal inverse yields the universal deficiency counts and six maximizers. Exact local covariances 87/64, 11/64 and 5/64 and endpoint covariances 3/16 and 1/16 yield the asserted finite variance; stationary bounded finite-dependence blocking gives a Gaussian limit with variance rate 119/64. Independent all-output enumeration over 8176 centers agrees with a separate suffix dynamic program; higher finite lengths confirm moments but are not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The all-window pointwise counting lemma and mean in arXiv:2610.15701v1 are openly credited. The inspected relevant full-text sections and actual index searches did not show this evaluated exact four-window population law, its six periodic extremal centers, the near-maximum polynomial census or the exact Gaussian fluctuation theorem. Distinct error models and known variance tables are not equivalents. A direct derivation from the old pointwise formula and an unindexed equivalent remain explicit risks.
residual_risks: The 2026 pointwise formula already allows computation of every center, so the new global evaluations are derived structural consequences, not a wholly independent mechanism.
Relevant literature may contain an unindexed equivalent transfer, finite spectrum or local-dependence CLT.
Only relevant passages rather than every line of the motivating full text were inspected; no exhaustive literature uniqueness claim is made.

value.rationale: The motivating paper singles out four-symbol sensing windows in a concrete molecular readout application. The complete all-length population histogram of ambiguity, exact polynomial near-extremal counts, and only-six-periodic-centers maximizer classification address motivated finite-length coding geometry beyond a pointwise enumeration formula or mean. The exact variance rate 119/64 and normal fluctuations quantify the robust typical/worst-case gap. No general code-size theorem is claimed; the object and invariant are natural for this error channel.
